power_cost_sensitivity.basis: One priced protected-conductor input varied against overhead; all physical quantities and other prices fixed
power_cost_sensitivity.limitations: Single-input operating-energy sensitivities hold grid-site rating, equipment quantities and vehicle mass fixed; no supplier price range, financing or physical protection rating is established

selected_control_electronics.basis: Baghdad-specific installed equipment and harness planning schedule within vehicle mass, power and price reserves

selected_reserved_guideway_capital.basis: Allocation within the installed estimate at the same quantities and rates. Fleet, stations, depots, grid, fixed tooling and section switchgear stay outside the allocation. Any partial line-power equipment is allocated by route share. Deferral and removal costs require a separate project design.

selected_service_allowance.annual_train_km_basis: planning allowance from hourly service offer on assigned passenger paths, with terminal layover; unlocated stops, junction capacity, intermediate dwell and passenger demand are not an established working timetable
selected_service_allowance.fleet_trainsets_basis: declared planning allowance; not derived from train rotations
selected_service_allowance.offered_places_basis: per service group at nominal peak headway; network timetable not established
selected_service_allowance.route_km_basis: costed planning guideway including non-revenue reservations

service_duty.basis: planning allowance from hourly service offer on assigned passenger paths, with terminal layover; unlocated stops, junction capacity, intermediate dwell and passenger demand are not an established working timetable

selected_service_allowance.stations_basis: planning allowance; individual stop sequence and opening status not established

selected_service_power.scope: Independent controls, light, brake and egress duty; traction supply excluded

selected_station_interfaces.conductor_side: outboard of each track, opposite the island
